payload.posture: Read Revelation 16:10–11 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the fifth bowl falls on the beast’s throne, darkening his kingdom while pain and blasphemy continue without repentance. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
